messages:
Rae: Tiny poll for the day: if the office could adopt one unofficial mascot (real or imaginary) what should it be? Pictures optional. :dog: :unicorn:
Arjun: An office cactus named 'Prickles' 3 because it survives neglect.
Marta: A tiny origami crane that lives on the CEO's desk and is apparently very opinionated.
Ben: My vote: a floppy-eared sock puppet called 'Socktopus' 3 performs all team standups.
Rae: @kudos-bot can you run a quick reaction poll?
kudos-bot: Poll created: "Office Mascot Pick"  Options: Prickles the Cactus / Origami Crane / Socktopus / Other
Arjun: Vote cast: Prickles the Cactus :cactus:
Marta: Vote cast: Origami Crane :bird:
Ben: Vote cast: Socktopus :octopus:
Rae: Voted Other ("Tiny Disco Ball" because vibes)
Arjun: If Prickles wins I will water it on Wednesdays.
Marta: Origami Crane requires a tiny acceptance speech. I can fold more.
Ben: Socktopus needs a tiny microphone prop. Low-effort puppet theater incoming.
Rae: Loser buys celebratory sparkling water? jk unless we need an incentive.
Marta: Agreement: if Other wins we make a tiny shrine for the disco ball.
Arjun: Winner gets a sticker for their laptop and the right to name the mascot.
Ben: Deal. Also leaving this here: who wants to help construct Socktopus tonight at 6?
Rae: I'm in for craft night. Will bring glue and sequins.
Marta: I will bring folding paper and a clever little speech.
kudos-bot: Thread archived to #random after 22 minutes."
